title: Velaikkaran
desc: Arivazhagan, a slum dweller, works in a large food company. However, when he realises that they adulterate the food, he strives to fight them.

title: Thug Life
desc: Adopted by a gang leader, Amaran faces suspicion after an assassination attempt.

title: Geetha Govindam
desc: Vijay Govind, a young lecturer in a college, wishes to get married at the earliest. He tries to woo Geetha, an independent and a level-headed woman, who is not easy to convince.

title: Panchamugi
desc: Panchamukhi, a wife and mother, leaves her family devastated when she dies according to a prophecy by Goddess Durga. However, her grieving husband encounters an exact lookalike of her in the city.

title: Pechi
desc: Accompanied by a guide, five friends go on a trekking trip to a haunted forest and despite being warned, they enter a restricted area that harbours an evil spirit.

title: Psycho
desc: A blind man, unable to prevent his lover's kidnapping by a psychopathic killer, becomes determined to rescue her from his deadly grasp.

title: Deja Vu
desc: An undercover police inspector investigates a mysterious abduction case of the daughter of the director general of police of a state which bears similarity with the description of a crime novelist.

title: Vathikuchi
desc: Autorickshaw driver Sakthi is head-over-heels in love with his neighbour, Leena. His world spirals into chaos when three ruthless criminals threaten his life.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Pa. Pandi
desc: Pandian Pazhanisami, a retired man, misses his youthful days and embarks on a mission to find his first love and reconnect with her.

title: Tej I Love You
desc: Tej, a young man, gets banished from his family for breaking his sister's marriage. He moves to London where he falls in love with a beautiful girl, Nandini.

title: Nani's Dasara
desc: In a gritty coal mining town, political tensions and power struggles complicate a love triangle between three longtime friends, testing their bonds.

title: Oru Nodi
desc: When a man goes missing under perplexing circumstances, a police inspector embarks on a quest to investigate the case, exposing a concealed network of political corruption.

title: Nandhi Varman
desc: Paranormal activities begin to happen when a crew starts excavating a temple that is believed to be concealed beneath the earth.

title: Anbarivu
desc: Twins, Anbu and Arivu, are separated at birth. Later, when their paths cross, the siblings are forced to switch families, as they strive to reunite their loved ones.

title: Engal Ayya
desc: A righteous professor rescues a student from the evil clutches of thugs and learns of her plight. After deciding to protect her from harm, he ends up falling in love with her.
